_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "opere" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "serie" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_issues" INTEGER NULL, "issn" TEXT NULL, "cover_image" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "edizioni" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "opera_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES opere (id), "serie_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES serie (id), "publisher" TEXT NULL, "issue_number" INTEGER NULL, "issue_number_label" TEXT NULL, "cover_image" TEXT NULL, "release_date" TEXT NULL, "cover_price" TEXT NULL, "page_count" INTEGER NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "ean" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "volume" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "printing_type" TEXT NULL, "classificazione" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "format" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scansioni" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" INTEGER NULL, "image" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "copie" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "edizione_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES edizioni (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "reading_status" TEXT NULL, "condition" TEXT NULL, "purchase_price" REAL NULL, "purchase_date" TEXT NULL, "seller" TEXT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "scansione_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES scansioni (id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "analisi_copertina" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "scansione_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scansioni (id), "title" TEXT NULL, "issue_number_label" TEXT NULL, "publisher" TEXT NULL, "series_name" TEXT NULL, "isbn" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "price" TEXT NULL, "release_date" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "page_count" INTEGER NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "issn" TEXT NULL, "characters" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "cover_style_tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "visual_element_tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "recognized_publisher_logo" TEXT NULL, "recognized_series_logo" TEXT NULL, "printing_type" TEXT NULL, "classificazione" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "raw_response" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "error_message" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "identificazione" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "scansione_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scansioni (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "error_message" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "candidati" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "identificazione_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES identificazione (id), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "edizione_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES edizioni (id), "title" TEXT NULL, "series_name" TEXT NULL, "issue_number_label" TEXT NULL, "publisher" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "cover_image_url" TEXT NULL, "punteggio" REAL NOT NULL, "scelto" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("scelto" IN (0, 1)), "description" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "creator" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "comic_creator" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "edizione_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES edizioni (id), "creator_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES creator (id), "ruolo" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("edizione_id", "creator_id", "ruolo"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tag" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "edizione_tag" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "edizione_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES edizioni (id), "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tag (id), UNIQUE ("edizione_id", "tag_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "comic_character" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "edizione_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES edizioni (id), "character_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id), UNIQUE ("edizione_id", "character_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "edizione_genere" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "edizione_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES edizioni (id), "genere" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("edizione_id", "genere"));
